title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa semua gaji yang dibayarkan kepada pejabat dan pegawai dalam dinas sipil harus dibayarkan dalam mata uang insular atau mata uang Amerika Serikat sesuai keputusan otoritas pengalokasian anggaran, serta mencabut Undang-Undang Nomor 34
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa semua gaji yang dibayar kepada pegawai dan kakitangan dalam perkhidmatan awam hendaklah dibayar dalam mata wang pulau atau mata wang Amerika Syarikat mengikut ketetapan pihak berkuasa peruntukan, serta membatalkan Akta Nombor 34

text.en:
All salaries and wages to be paid to officers and employees in the civil service of these islands,
insular, provincial, or municipal, shall hereafter be paid in money of the United States or in local currency, as
shall be provided in the Act making appropriation for such payment. In case the appropriating authority shall
order payment to be made in local currency, the ratio of local currency to money of the United States shall be
that fixed for the quarter for which the appropriations are made, by proclamation of the Civil Governor at the
beginning of the quarter.
Act Numbered Thirty-four, so far as it is in conflict with section one of this Act, is hereby

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 8, 1901.
